observations: Real clip (00:00.000-00:11.875): The robot rotates left between parked bikes/scooters (00:00.000-00:03.250), drives forward toward a trash bin where another small grey robot is parked (00:03.500-00:07.750), collides head-on with the small robot at 00:08.000, and then reverses and turns left (00:09.500-00:11.875).
Old policy in twin (00:00.000-00:02.750): The robot drives straight forward without steering away and collides directly with the cylindrical obstacle at 00:01.750 (min_clearance 0.031 m).

New policy in twin (00:00.000-00:04.750): The robot smoothly steers left to curve around the obstacle (00:00.250-00:02.000), passes it with safe clearance (0.271 m nominal, 0.316 m min across 40 variants), and straightens back onto its forward heading (00:02.250-00:04.750) at a controlled speed (~0.94 m/s).
